description: Source code for the AudioTimeStretcher class implementing WSOLA-based audio time stretching, including initialization, buffer management, and WSOLA iteration logic.

classes.name: AudioTimeStretcher
classes.description: Class implementing WSOLA-based audio time stretching with buffer management and iteration control.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the audio stretcher with sample type, channels, and sample rate, setting up buffers and windows.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads requested number of frames at a given playback rate, performing WSOLA iterations as needed.

methods.name: FlushBuffers
methods.description: Clears internal buffers and resets state for new processing.

methods.name: EnqueueBuffer
methods.description: Appends new audio data to the internal buffer queue.

methods.name: IsQueueFull
methods.description: Checks if the internal buffer queue has reached capacity.

methods.name: CanPerformWsola
methods.description: Determines if enough data is available to perform a WSOLA iteration.

methods.name: ConvertMillisecondsToFrames
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to frame count based on sample rate.

methods.name: RunOneWsolaIteration
methods.description: Performs a single WSOLA iteration to adjust audio timing.

methods.name: UpdateOutputTime
methods.description: Updates the output time and search region based on playback rate and time change.

methods.name: RemoveOldInputFrames
methods.description: Removes outdated input frames from buffer and adjusts indices.

methods.name: WriteCompletedFramesTo
methods.description: Copies processed frames from internal buffer to output.

methods.name: TargetIsWithinSearchRegion
methods.description: Checks if the target block is within the current search region.

methods.name: GetOptimalBlock
methods.description: Finds the most similar block to the target for WSOLA processing.

methods.name: PeekAudioWithZeroPrepend
methods.description: Prepares audio data with zero-padding for boundary conditions.
